definition: Causing terror through a deadly, unnatural gaze.
author: Bram Stoker
quote: But as I did so the head turned, and the eyes fell full upon me, with all their blaze of basilisk horror.
example_sentence: She fixed the waiter with a basilisk stare until the bill arrived.
